**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Client:

- **§ 2(a) (p0022/p0024)** affirmatively preserves our freedom: Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," qualified only by TrueLink IP non-infringement and existing § 10 confidentiality duties — standard protections, not restraints on our business.
- **§ 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client)** contains only compliance, non-representation, access-control, anti-spam and Client Content warranties. The "Non-Competition Agreement" cited in § 8(d) limits **TrueLink's** licence to use Credit Data, so it runs in our favour.
- **§ 3(i) (p0042)** credit-report ordering applies only where Client chooses to use the Interface and coexists with our express right to use alternatives — a sourcing mechanic, not exclusivity.
- The ordinary-course business description in the grant scopes TrueLink's licence rather than restricting Client's activities.

No redline proposed.
